sections.heading: Open source. Yours to extend.
body: Aglyn is Apache-2.0 — fork it, self-host it with Docker, and extend it with a plugin architecture and a REST API. The whole platform is built the same way you’d build on it.

sections.heading: Most website platforms are black boxes. Aglyn is the opposite — Apache-2.0, built from plugins, and driven by an API — so you can see how it works and make it your own.

items.title: Apache-2.0, end to end
items.body: Read the source, fork it, and self-host the entire platform with Docker — no black boxes.

items.title: Built from plugins
items.body: Commerce, bookings, email, workflows and more ship as plugins on the same architecture you build against.

items.title: Self-host with Docker
items.body: Run it yourself with Docker and your own Firebase project, or use the hosted platform — the code is the same either way.

items.title: A real marketplace
items.body: Install templates, layouts, and schemas — or package and sell your own (Pro and up).

items.title: REST API & keys
items.body: Automate datasets and read your sites, contacts, and form data with scoped API keys (Business and up).

items.title: Extend the canvas
items.body: Add blocks and console panels through the plugin system, right where they fit.

sections.heading: Wire it to the rest of your stack.
body: Trigger automations on real events — form submissions, bookings, sign-ups — call out to your own services with webhooks, or drive datasets through the REST API with scoped keys.

items.title: Event-driven automations
items.body: Run steps when forms, bookings, sign-ups, or page views happen.

items.title: Outbound webhooks
items.body: POST to your own services on any event (Business and up).

items.title: REST API & keys
items.body: Read and write datasets with scoped API keys (Business and up).

sections.heading: Fork it, extend it, ship it.

items.title: Start from the source
items.body: Clone the Apache-2.0 repo and self-host it with Docker, or use the hosted platform.

items.title: Extend it
items.body: Add plugins and blocks, or call the REST API with scoped keys.

items.title: Publish & share
items.body: Ship your sites, and publish templates or listings to the marketplace.

items.title: Plugins
items.body: Install templates & layouts, or publish your own.

items.title: Workflows
items.body: Automate the busywork with triggers & actions.

items.title: Analytics
items.body: Privacy-first traffic, top pages & store revenue.

sections.heading: Build on an open platform.
body: Read the source, self-host it, and extend Aglyn however you need.
